notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary Request Attribute Value Update service boundaries. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and federation identity. Direct mappings in both TCK catalogs are limited to instance/class Request Attribute Value Update solicitation and its owner callback (Clause 6.21), request-tag propagation to Provide Attribute Value Update (Clause 6.21.5), and the ordinary Update/Reflect response values and tag (Clause 6.10). Invalid ObjectClass/Attribute failures and their no-callback checks are supplemental assertions; federation setup, discovery, and cleanup are fixture behavior. The class overload exercises a single base-class object and does not assert subclass expansion or multi-instance fan-out. This remains experimental public-API evidence, not conformance evidence, and asserts no provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.
